steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出下腔靜脈濾器的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Inferior vena cava filter and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 已正確完成「放置指徵」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: 'Indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「放置指徵」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出胸廓出口症候群減壓的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Thoracic outlet decompression.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：第一肋切除與斜角肌切除。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: First-rib resection and scalenectomy.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依胸廓出口症候群減壓的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Thoracic outlet decompression.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 胸廓出口症候群減壓的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Thoracic outlet decompression.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：第一肋切除與斜角肌切除
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: First-rib resection and scalenectomy
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」在胸廓出口症候群減壓中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'First-rib resection and scalenectomy' within Thoracic outlet decompression, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'First-rib resection and scalenectomy': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'First-rib resection and scalenectomy'.
steps.failure: 若「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'First-rib resection and scalenectomy' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'First-rib resection and scalenectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」是胸廓出口症候群減壓的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'First-rib resection and scalenectomy' is a core component of Thoracic outlet decompression; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: First-rib resection and scalenectomy'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'First-rib resection and scalenectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'First-rib resection and scalenectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出胸廓出口症候群減壓的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Thoracic outlet decompression and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「第一肋切除與斜角肌切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'First-rib resection and scalenectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出下肢截肢與義肢準備的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：截肢平面選擇、皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Level selection, flap design and residual-limb shaping.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 已正確完成「截肢平面選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'Level selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'flap design and residual-limb shaping' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依下肢截肢與義肢準備的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 下肢截肢與義肢準備的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：截肢平面選擇
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「截肢平面選擇」在下肢截肢與義肢準備中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Level selection' within Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「截肢平面選擇」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Level selection': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「截肢平面選擇」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Level selection'.
steps.failure: 若「截肢平面選擇」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Level selection' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「截肢平面選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Level selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「截肢平面選擇」是下肢截肢與義肢準備的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Level selection' is a core component of Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：截肢平面選擇」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Level selection'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「截肢平面選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Level selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: flap design and residual-limb shaping
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」在下肢截肢與義肢準備中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'flap design and residual-limb shaping' within Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'flap design and residual-limb shaping': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'flap design and residual-limb shaping'.
steps.failure: 若「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'flap design and residual-limb shaping' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'flap design and residual-limb shaping' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」是下肢截肢與義肢準備的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'flap design and residual-limb shaping' is a core component of Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: flap design and residual-limb shaping'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「皮瓣設計與殘肢塑形」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'flap design and residual-limb shaping' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「截肢平面選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Level selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出下肢截肢與義肢準備的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Lower-limb amputation and prosthetic preparation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「截肢平面選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Level selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「截肢平面選擇」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Level selection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出血管創傷修復的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Vascular trauma repair.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：硬徵象、暫時性分流與血管修補原則。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Hard signs, temporary shunting and principles of repair.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: 'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「硬徵象」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Hard signs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依血管創傷修復的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Vascular trauma repair.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 血管創傷修復的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Vascular trauma repair.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：硬徵象
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「硬徵象」在血管創傷修復中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Hard signs' within Vascular trauma repair, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「硬徵象」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Hard signs': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「硬徵象」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Hard signs'.
steps.failure: 若「硬徵象」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Hard signs' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「硬徵象」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Hard signs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「硬徵象」是血管創傷修復的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Hard signs' is a core component of Vascular trauma repair; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：硬徵象」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Hard signs'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「硬徵象」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Hard signs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：暫時性分流與血管修補原則
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: temporary shunting and principles of repair
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」在血管創傷修復中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'temporary shunting and principles of repair' within Vascular trauma repair, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'temporary shunting and principles of repair': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'temporary shunting and principles of repair'.
steps.failure: 若「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'temporary shunting and principles of repair' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」是血管創傷修復的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'temporary shunting and principles of repair' is a core component of Vascular trauma repair; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：暫時性分流與血管修補原則」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: temporary shunting and principles of repair'?
options: 已正確完成「硬徵象」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: 'Hard signs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出血管創傷修復的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Vascular trauma repair and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「硬徵象」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
'Hard signs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 已正確完成「暫時性分流與血管修補原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: 'temporary shunting and principles of repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 機制與病理生理（免費試學）

steps.title: 機制與病理生理
steps.objective: 掌握急性腸繫膜缺血的背景與基本機制。
steps.objectiveEn: Grasp the background and basic mechanism of Acute mesenteric ischaemia.
steps.instruction: 閱讀並整理：CT 血管攝影、血管內再通與腸切除。
steps.instructionEn: Read and organise: CTA, endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection.
steps.observation: 以流程圖畫出因果鏈。
steps.observationEn: Draw the causal chain as a flow diagram.
steps.failure: 把相關性誤認為因果是最常見的推理錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking correlation for causation is the most common reasoning error.
steps.check: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

knowledge.title: 核心摘要
knowledge.text: CT 血管攝影、血管內再通與腸切除。
knowledge.textEn: CTA, endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection.

knowledge.title: 術語
knowledge.text: 先定義名詞，再討論機制。
knowledge.textEn: Define terms before discussing mechanisms.

quiz.question: 「機制與病理生理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Mechanism and pathophysiology'?
options: 病例推理完整。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵名詞與分類
steps.objective: 建立本題的名詞表與分類架構。
steps.objectiveEn: Build the glossary and classification for this topic.
steps.instruction: 列出 8–12 個關鍵名詞，各以一句話定義，並以表格呈現分類。
steps.instructionEn: List 8–12 key terms with one-sentence definitions and tabulate the classification.
steps.observation: 完成名詞表。
steps.observationEn: Complete the glossary.
steps.failure: 名詞混用會導致後續判斷錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mixing terms leads to later misjudgement.
steps.check: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
steps.checkEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.

knowledge.title: 分類的目的
knowledge.text: 分類應服務於治療決策或預後。
knowledge.textEn: Classification should serve treatment decisions or prognosis.

quiz.question: 「關鍵名詞與分類」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key terms and classification'?
options: 病例推理完整。
已正確完成「CT 血管攝影」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「血管內再通與腸切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
'CTA' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 臨床表現與診斷

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：CT 血管攝影
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「CT 血管攝影」在急性腸繫膜缺血中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'CTA' within Acute mesenteric ischaemia, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「CT 血管攝影」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'CTA': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「CT 血管攝影」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'CTA'.
steps.failure: 若「CT 血管攝影」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'CTA' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「CT 血管攝影」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'CTA' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「CT 血管攝影」是急性腸繫膜缺血的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'CTA' is a core component of Acute mesenteric ischaemia; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：CT 血管攝影」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: CTA'?
options: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
已正確完成「CT 血管攝影」並以文字或數據留下證據。
病例推理完整。
已正確完成「血管內再通與腸切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.
'CTA' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Case reasoning complete.
'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：血管內再通與腸切除
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「血管內再通與腸切除」在急性腸繫膜缺血中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' within Acute mesenteric ischaemia, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「血管內再通與腸切除」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「血管內再通與腸切除」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection'.
steps.failure: 若「血管內再通與腸切除」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「血管內再通與腸切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「血管內再通與腸切除」是急性腸繫膜缺血的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' is a core component of Acute mesenteric ischaemia; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：血管內再通與腸切除」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection'?
options: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
已正確完成「血管內再通與腸切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
病例推理完整。
optionsEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.
'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Case reasoning complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 治療與實證

steps.title: 治療與實證
steps.objective: 整合治療原則、證據等級與現代意義。
steps.objectiveEn: Integrate treatment principles, evidence levels and modern relevance.
steps.instruction: 列出一線與二線做法、支持證據（試驗／指引／經典條文）與限制。
steps.instructionEn: List first- and second-line approaches, supporting evidence (trials/guidelines/classical passages) and limitations.
steps.observation: 寫一段 150 字總結。
steps.observationEn: Write a 150-word summary.
steps.failure: 證據等級與推薦強度不可混淆。
steps.failureEn: Evidence level and recommendation strength are not the same thing.
steps.check: 總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
steps.checkEn: The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.

knowledge.title: 證據金字塔
knowledge.text: 系統性回顧與 RCT 位於頂端，專家意見在底層。
knowledge.textEn: Systematic reviews and RCTs sit at the top; expert opinion at the bottom.

quiz.question: 「治療與實證」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Treatment and evidence'?
options: 病例推理完整。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
已正確完成「血管內再通與腸切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 病例應用與自我測驗
steps.objective: 以一個病例或情境應用本題。
steps.objectiveEn: Apply the topic to a case or scenario.
steps.instruction: 描述情境→列出鑑別→選擇處置→預測結果→比較實際。
steps.instructionEn: Describe the scenario → list differentials → choose management → predict outcome → compare with reality.
steps.observation: 完成病例紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Complete the case record.
steps.failure: 跳過鑑別診斷直接下結論是危險的捷徑。
steps.failureEn: Skipping the differential is a dangerous shortcut.
steps.check: 病例推理完整。
steps.checkEn: Case reasoning complete.

knowledge.title: 反思
knowledge.text: 每個病例都應回答：我學到什麼、下次會怎麼做。
knowledge.textEn: Every case should answer: what did I learn, what will I do differently.

quiz.question: 「病例應用與自我測驗」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Case application and self-test'?
options: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
已正確完成「CT 血管攝影」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「血管內再通與腸切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
病例推理完整。
optionsEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.
'CTA' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'endovascular reperfusion and bowel resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Case reasoning complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出腎動脈狹窄介入的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Renal artery stenosis intervention.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：纖維肌性發育不良與動脈粥樣硬化的治療差異。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Fibromuscular dysplasia versus atherosclerotic disease.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 已正確完成「纖維肌性發育不良與動脈粥樣硬化的治療差異」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: 'Fibromuscular dysplasia versus atherosclerotic disease' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
